# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The current 1.1.x line on `main` is supported on a **best-effort** basis;
earlier versions are not actively maintained.

| Version | Security updates |
| --- | --- |
| 1.1.x (`main`) | Best-effort |
| Earlier versions | Not actively supported |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report potential vulnerabilities **privately** through the
[GitHub security advisory form](https://github.com/bpangburn/jedison/security/advisories/new).
Do not post exploit details in a public issue.

Include the affected version/commit, impact, and reproduction steps.
We aim to acknowledge reports within seven days where feasible, but
cannot guarantee a particular fix or release schedule. Confirmed
issues may be resolved and disclosed through a coordinated advisory.
